ownerDecision.condition: Every exact raw payload and each required derived payload must first have repository-integrated immutable archive readback evidence. Approval does not itself satisfy that condition.

requirements: remote byte length matching local evidence
remote full-object checksum matching local SHA-256 or independently verified full-object checksum
active COMPLIANCE retention through at least 2033-08-12T00:00:00Z

refreshAndAuthority.representation: Each publication is a separately archived as-of snapshot; never label it real-time or overwrite an earlier snapshot.
refreshAndAuthority.schedule: Attempt at the existing four America/Vancouver refresh slots; a schedule is not a publisher freshness guarantee.
refreshAndAuthority.failurePolicy: Reject empty, capped, partial, schema-drifted, invalid, checksum-unbound or unarchived input; retain the last good release and mark it degraded, then stale after 24 hours.
refreshAndAuthority.precedence: Within a province, the responsible provincial wildfire agency source prevails over CWFIS when records conflict. CWFIS is national fallback context only.
refreshAndAuthority.safety: No source is emergency direction, a damage map, a mortality map or a completeness guarantee. Link users to the responsible agency.

sources.transformation: Source-preserving field normalization and EPSG:3978-to-EPSG:4326 reprojection only; retain the raw archive and source identifiers.
sources.ingestion: Admit only records valid at the fixed query instant with all 586 point geometries and exact source provenance.
sources.release: Label as an as-of national point snapshot and fallback context; it is not real-time, not a complete incident or perimeter inventory, and not provincial-agency authoritative.

sources.role: British Columbia provincial current-season perimeter context
sources.transformation: Use only the checksum-bound derived release: copy 215 raw-valid features unchanged, replace G70362 with its bounded valid polygonal repair, and permanently exclude and quarantine V10755 from geometry-dependent use.
sources.ingestion: Closed join to the 216 admitted derived features; never ingest V10755 geometry and never mutate or substitute the 217-feature raw archive.
sources.release: Disclose 216 admitted perimeters from a 217-feature snapshot and one permanent geometry exclusion; never claim 217-feature geometry coverage.

sources.transformation: Source-preserving field normalization only; retain every raw point and publisher status without inferring a perimeter.
sources.ingestion: Admit 751 valid points with exact snapshot provenance and status dates; do not derive perimeter area from points.
sources.release: Label as an as-of wildfire-location snapshot, not real-time and not a complete perimeter dataset; Alberta Wildfire remains authoritative.

sources.transformation: Use only the checksum-bound closed-join derived release: copy 179 raw-valid features unchanged and use all nine recorded bounded valid polygonal repairs, with no exclusion or deduplication.
sources.ingestion: Require 188 distinct source object IDs and 188 valid non-empty polygonal derived counterparts with attributes preserved.
sources.release: Disclose a daily as-of in-year snapshot with nine bounded repairs and zero exclusions; it is not a publisher freshness or completeness guarantee.

pipeline.activationRule: Primary exact-version/COMPLIANCE archive evidence is complete for the four raw and two derived payload/manifest pairs, but recovery-replica evidence remains separate. Production eligibility remains fail-closed until separate transformation, ingestion, release, and production-admission evidence is validated.
